'''May 2001 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at DJ's Comics, Meriden, Connecticut on 12 May 2001. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2314">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-meriden-ct-5-12-01-cpa-auditd2314/ meriden-ct-5-12-01-cpa-audit], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 16 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-16-meriden-ct-5-12-01-cpa-auditd2314/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' DJ's Comics, Meriden, Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
